detail.body:
## Overview

`ROCM_AITER_FA` runs prefill and extend attention through CK in bf16/fp16, even with an FP8 KV cache. This PR runs eligible head-dim-256 calls on gfx942 through aiter's Triton MHA on per-tensor FP8 Q/K/V. It is enabled by an FP8 KV cache plus `--attention-config '{"use_prefill_query_quantization": true}'`, the switch MLA already uses (#31195). Without the switch, every call still goes to CK.

## Claims

- No new env var; `envs.py` and `_aiter_ops.py` are untouched. With the switch off, the layer calls CK directly, and the existing `tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa.py` gives the same result with and without this PR.
- Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, 131072 input tokens, TP1, measured on this head: median TTFT −14.2%, output throughput +12.3%, median TPOT −7.6% on MI325X; −11.5% / +11.3% / −8.6% on MI300X. Gains shrink with input length and are neutral at 4096.
- The fresh-server first pass is no longer slower than base. At 16384 it was +11% slower on revision `209d4e9c37`; on this head it is +0.2% (MI325X) and −2.2% (MI300X).
- Long-context accuracy is unchanged. NIAH at 133k tokens scores 5/5 on both base and this PR at every needle depth, which exercises the extend/context-chunk path that gsm8k does not reach. The worst per-head relative error against CK in the unit tests is 0.059 on the output and 2.5e-3 on the LSE.
- Fewer request-time Triton compiles: with `max_seqlen_q/k` rounded up to a multiple of 16, 42 mixed calls compile 6 `_attn_fwd` variants instead of 17, with bitwise-identical outputs.
- Ineligible bf16/fp16 calls and calls with unknown kwargs run the CK call unchanged. An aiter whose `_flash_attn_forward` lacks the needed kwargs keeps the layer on CK from load time. Kernel errors, including OOM, raise; there is no per-call fallback.
- The FP8 Q/K/V buffers come from vLLM's workspace manager and are reserved during the profile run, so the memory profiler accounts for them. The FP8 path adds no GPU-to-CPU sync.
- Untouched: decode, other head dims, other architectures including gfx950, CUDA, and `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT`.

## Why `_TUNED_CONFIG` is here

aiter's gfx942 MHA config has no FP8 head-dim-256 entry, so `_get_config` falls through to `fwd["default"]` (`PRELOAD_V` false, `num_warps` 4, `num_stages` 1). On that config the Triton FP8 path is **slower than the CK path this PR replaces**, so the local override is load-bearing rather than a convenience.

MI325X, head dim 256, 24 query heads, 4 KV heads, aiter 0.1.26, median of 5 after 3 warmups. A second pass agreed within 1% on every cell, and MI300X shows the same pattern.

| case (q × k) | CK bf16 | Triton FP8, aiter default | Triton FP8, tuned |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4096 × 4096, causal | 0.731 ms | 1.907 ms | 0.559 ms |
| 16384 × 16384, causal | 8.795 ms | 23.189 ms | 6.116 ms |
| 30720 × 30720, causal | 30.149 ms | 79.473 ms | 20.720 ms |
| 30720 × 16384, context chunk | 32.014 ms | 75.123 ms | 19.768 ms |
| 30720 × 32768, context chunk | 63.642 ms | 151.799 ms | 39.151 ms |

The tuned config is 24–38% faster than CK; aiter's default is 2.3–2.6× slower. This resembles the pipelining pathology aiter documents one branch higher in `_get_config` for `16 < head_dim_v <= 64` ("a num_stages=1 software-pipelining pathology on this backend (e.g. ~3x slower at d64)"), fixed there by adding a `small_head` entry. I will send a gfx942 FP8 head-dim-256 entry to aiter the same way; once it lands and the pin moves, `_TUNED_CONFIG` here is a one-line deletion.

## Validation

MI325X (gfx942) and MI300X (gfx942), TP1, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm72-5d35ce3934a7804b298559d2d99eec33792e1eb9` (AITER 0.1.26, torch 2.13.0, Triton 3.8.0). "This PR" is that image with the diff applied in place.

All serving and accuracy numbers below were re-measured on this head. The earlier tables from revision `209d4e9c37` are not reused: the extend and context-chunk path changed numerically in this round, since the gathered FP8 context is now read with the cache's own scales instead of being dequantised to bf16 and requantised with a fresh per-call scale. Both arms were run with the identical script on the same host, base first.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_CUSTOM_AR=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=0 \
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --attention-config '{"use_prefill_query_quantization": true}' \
  --max-model-len 133120 --max-num-seqs 8 --max-num-batched-tokens 30720 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --no-enable-prefix-caching

vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len $ISL --random-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 24 \
  --max-concurrency 8 --num-warmups 0 --seed 1234 --ignore-eos
```

Each machine ran both arms with the identical script, base first. "first pass" is
the benchmark run immediately after the server starts, so it carries Triton compile
cost; "steady state" is the second pass on the same server. That split matters
because the first pass is the one that regressed on `209d4e9c37`.

**MI325X**

| input tokens | median TTFT ms, first pass | median TTFT ms, steady state | output tok/s | median TPOT ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4096 | 2674.7 → 2664.0 (−0.4%) | 2433.7 → 2662.9 (noise, see below) | 555.0 → 554.0 | 12.02 → 11.88 |
| 16384 | 8451.6 → 8466.8 (+0.2%) | 7560.1 → 7401.9 (−2.1%) | 350.2 → 353.6 (+1.0%) | 15.44 → 15.40 |
| 32768 | 16070.0 → 15289.9 (−4.9%) | 14954.9 → 14156.0 (−5.3%) | 220.8 → 227.6 (+3.0%) | 21.62 → 21.33 |
| 131072 | 77059.4 → 68470.4 (−11.1%) | 76640.9 → 65798.8 (**−14.2%**) | 54.1 → 60.7 (**+12.3%**) | 73.06 → 67.53 (−7.6%) |

**MI300X**

| input tokens | median TTFT ms, first pass | median TTFT ms, steady state | output tok/s | median TPOT ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4096 | 3293.7 → 3286.3 (−0.2%) | 3275.7 → 3270.9 (−0.1%) | 473.2 → 475.5 | 13.71 → 13.66 |
| 16384 | 10921.5 → 10679.0 (−2.2%) | 9351.2 → 9171.8 (−1.9%) | 290.3 → 294.0 (+1.3%) | 18.45 → 18.27 |
| 32768 | 20182.7 → 19433.9 (−3.7%) | 18536.3 → 17752.4 (−4.2%) | 181.2 → 186.7 (+3.0%) | 26.06 → 25.51 |
| 131072 | 94312.7 → 87221.6 (−7.5%) | 93987.1 → 83140.3 (**−11.5%**) | 44.2 → 49.1 (**+11.3%**) | 89.33 → 81.63 (−8.6%) |

Throughput and TPOT are from the steady-state pass.

The base arm reproduces the previously posted baseline: 76640.9 ms here against
75772 ms on `209d4e9c37` at 131072 on MI325X, 1.1% apart. So these deltas can be
read against the table that was already in this PR.

On `209d4e9c37` the first pass at 16384 was 11% slower than base (7442 → 8294 ms),
because Triton specialised the kernel on every distinct max sequence length.
Rounding `max_seqlen_q/k` up to a multiple of 16 removed that: over 42 prefill,
extend and context-chunk calls, variants drop from 17 to 6 with bitwise-identical
outputs. The PR is no longer slower than base on a fresh server at any input length
measured. It still warms up more than base does — at 131072 on MI325X its own first
pass to steady state improves 68470 → 65799 ms — but even its first pass beats
base's steady state.

At 4096 the two machines disagree in sign and the effect is inside the noise:
base's own two passes at 4096 on MI325X differ by 9.9%, which is larger than the
base-to-PR difference there. That input length is reported as neutral.

The reported `GPU KV cache size` was 6,150,749 tokens on base and 6,152,261 on
this PR (MI325X), and identical on MI300X, so reserving the FP8 buffers in the
profile run did not measurably reduce KV cache capacity at this configuration.

**NIAH at 133k tokens, MI325X.** `--max-num-batched-tokens 30720` splits a
133,063-token prompt into 5 chunked-prefill steps, so every one runs
`extend_forward` with context chunks — the path gsm8k does not reach. Greedy,
one needle per run:

| needle depth | expected code | base | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5% | QX-4471 | hit | hit |
| 25% | ZM-8832 | hit | hit |
| 50% | KP-1059 | hit | hit |
| 75% | TR-6624 | hit | hit |
| 95% | BW-9317 | hit | hit |
| **score** | | **5/5** | **5/5** |

Both arms produced the same first generated token.

gsm8k 5-shot, re-measured on this head, MI325X (1319 problems, 5-shot,
`--apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn`):

| thinking | metric | base | this PR | difference |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| off | flexible-extract | 0.9666 ± 0.0049 | 0.9689 ± 0.0048 | +0.0023 |
| off | strict-match | 0.9659 ± 0.0050 | 0.9674 ± 0.0049 | +0.0015 |
| on | flexible-extract | 0.9606 ± 0.0054 | 0.9666 ± 0.0049 | +0.0060 |
| on | strict-match | 0.8795 ± 0.0090 | 0.8704 ± 0.0093 | −0.0091 |

Every difference is within about one standard error of zero, in both directions,
so none of them is a signal. These are unpaired comparisons with per-run standard
errors; the earlier table on revision `209d4e9c37` reported paired differences and
McNemar p-values, which this rerun cannot reproduce because per-sample outputs
were not logged.

gsm8k prompts run as plain prefills and never reach the extend or context-chunk
path that this round changed, so this table shows the plain-prefill path is
unaffected. The NIAH result above is what covers the changed path.

```bash
lm-eval run --model local-chat-completions \
  --model_args "model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions,tokenized_requests=False,max_gen_toks=2048,num_concurrent=8" \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --apply_chat_template --fewshot_as_multiturn
```

Thinking off adds `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'` to `vllm serve`. Thinking on adds `--gen_kwargs 'until=["<|im_end|>"]'` to `lm-eval`, because gsm8k's default `Question:` stop string cuts the model's reasoning short. gsm8k prompts run as plain prefills, so they do not reach the extend path; the NIAH table above covers that path, and the unit tests compare it against CK.

```bash
pytest -v tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_triton_fp8_prefill.py
pytest -v tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa.py
```

MI300X, on this head: 72 passed, and 94 passed, 1 xfailed. On base, the FP8 file errors out (module missing) and `test_rocm_aiter_fa.py` gives the same 94 passed, 1 xfailed. `test_rocm_aiter_fa.py` is taken at the image's commit.

## Details

- `enabled()` decides at layer init whether the FP8 Triton path is used; `prefill_attn()` then builds the varlen callable. The three call sites in `rocm_aiter_fa.py` call `self._prefill_attn(...)`.
- `triton_fp8_prefill_attn()` quantises Q with `ops.scaled_fp8_quant` into a workspace buffer (one scale per tensor per call) and calls aiter's `_flash_attn_forward`. K and V are quantised the same way when they arrive in `q`'s dtype, and passed through untouched when the caller supplies `descale_k`/`descale_v`, which the module broadcasts to `[batch, num_kv_heads]`.
- One scale per tensor per call, so results are not batch invariant.
- Causal calls must pass one tensor for both `cu_seqlens`, because aiter writes LSE 0 for causal rows with no key (ROCm/aiter#6180).
- On the NHD cache layout, the gathered context chunk and a KV-sharing layer's K/V are read from the cache as FP8 with the cache's own scales as `descale_k`/`descale_v`, with no dequantise-then-requantise round trip. The shuffle layout still dequantises and requantises; that path is unchanged and not validated for the direct read.
- `max_seqlen_q/k` are rounded up to a multiple of 16. With varlen inputs the kernel reads real lengths from `cu_seqlens`, so only Triton's specialisation changes.
- The FP8 Q/K/V buffers are reserved from the workspace manager during the profile run, together with a one-off allocation of aiter's float32 output and its cast, so the memory profiler counts them. At the configuration measured above this did not change the reported KV cache size. ROCm/aiter#7232 (draft) adds `out_dtype` to `_flash_attn_forward`; once vLLM's aiter pin has it the kernel can write bf16 directly instead of a float32 buffer that is then converted. This PR does not depend on it.
- Scope: gfx942, head dim 256, FP8 E4M3 KV cache, prefill and extend only, and only layers without ALiBi, attention sinks or a sliding window. Other layers stay on CK and log why. Only TP1 was measured.
- Not a duplicate: #53823 (gfx950) and #63679 touch the same call sites, and #58713 (draft) touches `extend_forward`. #53823 adds the same direct FP8 context gather for its prequantised path; whichever lands second will reuse the other's switch. None adds FP8 prefill for gfx942. If they land first, I will rebase.

+> **Note:** On ROCm, the `ROCM_AITER_FA` backend can run prefill attention in FP8 on gfx942 for head size 256, with an FP8 KV cache and `--attention-config '{"use_prefill_query_quantization": true}'`. Queries and new keys and values get one dynamic scale per tensor per call, so results are not batch invariant.

 ### Supported FP8 KV-Cache Quantization Schemes
 
 vLLM supports two main quantization strategies for the FP8 KV-cache:

@@ -0,0 +1,1070 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Routing, fallback and accuracy tests for the ROCM_AITER_FA FP8 prefill path."""
+
+import functools
+import importlib
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+    pytest.skip("ROCm AITER FP8 prefill tests", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+pytest.importorskip("aiter.ops.triton.attention.mha")
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import (
+    _CP_TOKENS_PER_ITER_ROCM as WORKSPACE_ROWS,
+)
+
+gfx942 = pytest.mark.skipif(get_cdna_version() != 3, reason="gfx942 only")
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures("workspace_init")
+
+HQ, HKV, HD = 24, 4, 256
+SEQ_LENS = [37, 64, 19]
+
+FP8 = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+FP8_MAX = torch.finfo(FP8).max
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def fp8():
+    mod = importlib.import_module(
+        "vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_triton_fp8_prefill"
+    )
+    mod._load_kernel.cache_clear()
+    yield mod
+    mod._load_kernel.cache_clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def kernel(monkeypatch):
+    import aiter.ops.triton.attention.mha as mha
+
+    calls = []
+
+    @functools.wraps(mha._flash_attn_forward)
+    def fake(q, k, v, **kw):
+        calls.append(SimpleNamespace(q=q, k=k, v=v, **kw))
+        o = torch.full(q.shape[:-1] + v.shape[-1:], 0.5, dtype=torch.float32)
+        lse = torch.arange(q.shape[0] * q.shape[1], dtype=torch.float32).view(
+            q.shape[0], q.shape[1]
+        )
+        return o.to(q.device), lse.to(q.device), None, 0, 0
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mha, "_flash_attn_forward", fake)
+    return calls
+
+
+class _Orig:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+        self.result = object()
+
+    def __call__(self, **kw):
+        self.calls.append(kw)
+        return self.result
+
+
+def _cu(seq_lens):
+    return torch.tensor(
+        [0, *torch.tensor(seq_lens).cumsum(0).tolist()], dtype=torch.int32
+    ).cuda()
+
+
+def _inputs(
+    hq=HQ,
+    hkv=HKV,
+    hd=HD,
+    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    k_dtype=None,
+    v_heads=None,
+    k_hd=None,
+    seq_lens=SEQ_LENS,
+):
+    t = sum(seq_lens)
+    cu = _cu(seq_lens)
+    q = torch.randn(t, hq, hd, device="cuda").to(dtype)
+    k = torch.randn(t, hkv, k_hd or hd, device="cuda").to(k_dtype or dtype)
+    v = torch.randn(t, v_heads or hkv, k_hd or hd, device="cuda").to(k_dtype or dtype)
+    return dict(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        cu_seqlens_q=cu,
+        cu_seqlens_k=cu,
+        max_seqlen_q=max(seq_lens),
+        max_seqlen_k=max(seq_lens),
+        min_seqlen_q=1,
+        dropout_p=0.0,
+        softmax_scale=hd**-0.5,
+        causal=True,
+        window_size=(-1, -1),
+        alibi_slopes=None,
+        return_lse=True,
+        sink_ptr=None,
+    )
+
+
+def _assert_same_args(call, args):
+    assert call.keys() == args.keys()
+    for name, value in args.items():
+        assert call[name] is value, name
+
+
+def _rel(a, b):
+    return ((a.float() - b.float()).norm() / b.float().norm()).item()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "switch, kv_cache_dtype, head_size, plain, wanted",
+    [
+        (True, "fp8", HD, True, True),
+        (True, "fp8_e4m3", HD, True, True),
+        (False, "fp8", HD, True, False),
+        (True, "auto", HD, True, False),
+        (True, "fp8_e5m2", HD, True, False),
+        (True, "fp8", 128, True, False),
+        (True, "fp8", HD, False, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_switch_selects_the_path(fp8, switch, kv_cache_dtype, head_size, plain, wanted):
+    on = wanted and get_cdna_version() == 3
+    assert fp8.enabled(switch, head_size, kv_cache_dtype, plain) is on
+    assert fp8._load_kernel.cache_info().currsize == int(on)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("config", ["on", "off", "none"])
+def test_impl_reads_the_attention_config(monkeypatch, fp8, config):
+    from vllm.config import AttentionConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends import rocm_aiter_fa
+
+    seen = []
+
+    def fake_enabled(*a):
+        seen.append(a)
+        return a[0]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(fp8, "enabled", fake_enabled)
+
+    def make():
+        return rocm_aiter_fa.AiterFlashAttentionImpl(
+            num_heads=HQ,
+            head_size=HD,
+            scale=HD**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=HKV,
+            alibi_slopes=None,
+            sliding_window=None,
+            kv_cache_dtype="fp8",
+        )
+
+    if config == "none":
+        impl = make()
+    else:
+        switch = AttentionConfig(use_prefill_query_quantization=config == "on")
+        with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig(attention_config=switch)):
+            impl = make()
+    assert seen == [(config == "on", HD, "fp8", True)]
+    assert impl.fp8_prefill is (config == "on")
+    if impl.fp8_prefill:
+        assert impl._prefill_attn.func is fp8.triton_fp8_prefill_attn
+        # Every other test passes orig= explicitly, so this is the only check
+        # that an ineligible call falls back to CK in production.
+        assert impl._prefill_attn.keywords == {
+            "orig": rocm_aiter_ops.flash_attn_varlen_func
+        }
+    else:
+        assert impl._prefill_attn is rocm_aiter_ops.flash_attn_varlen_func
+
+
+@gfx942
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layer", ["plain", "alibi", "sliding_window", "sinks"])
+def test_layers_triton_cannot_serve_stay_on_ck(fp8, layer):
+    from vllm.config import AttentionConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends import rocm_aiter_fa
+
+    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = dict(alibi_slopes=None, sliding_window=None)
+    if layer == "alibi":
+        kwargs["alibi_slopes"] = [1.0] * HQ
+    elif layer == "sliding_window":
+        kwargs["sliding_window"] = 128
+    elif layer == "sinks":
+        kwargs["sinks"] = torch.zeros(HQ, device="cuda")
+    switch = AttentionConfig(use_prefill_query_quantization=True)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig(attention_config=switch)):
+        impl = rocm_aiter_fa.AiterFlashAttentionImpl(
+            num_heads=HQ,
+            head_size=HD,
+            scale=HD**-0.5,
+            num_kv_heads=HKV,
+            kv_cache_dtype="fp8",
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+    assert impl.fp8_prefill is (layer == "plain")
+    if not impl.fp8_prefill:
+        assert impl._prefill_attn is rocm_aiter_ops.flash_attn_varlen_func
+
+
+ACCEPT = {
+    "gqa_bf16": {},
+    "gqa_fp16": dict(make=dict(dtype=torch.float16)),
+    "mha_equal_heads": dict(make=dict(hq=8, hkv=8)),
+    "mqa_single_kv_head": dict(make=dict(hq=8, hkv=1)),
+    "non_causal": dict(call=dict(causal=False)),
+    "non_causal_separate_offsets": dict(call=dict(causal=False), separate_k=True),
+    "no_lse": dict(call=dict(return_lse=False)),
+    "window_none": dict(call=dict(window_size=None)),
+    "single_sequence": dict(make=dict(seq_lens=[129])),
+}
+
+DECLINE: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
+    "q_not_3d": dict(q_2d=True),
+    "head_dim_128": dict(make=dict(hd=128)),
+    "kv_head_dim_mismatch": dict(make=dict(k_hd=128)),
+    "dtype_fp32": dict(make=dict(dtype=torch.float32)),

+def _load_kernel() -> ModuleType | None:
+    try:
+        import aiter.ops.triton.attention.mha as mha
+
+        params = inspect.signature(mha._flash_attn_forward).parameters
+        missing = _KERNEL_KWARGS - params.keys()
+        if missing:
+            raise TypeError(f"_flash_attn_forward has no {sorted(missing)}")
+        impl = getattr(mha, "_MHA_IMPL", "default")
+        if impl != "default":
+            raise RuntimeError(f"aiter MHA impl {impl!r} has no FP8 path")
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("FP8 Triton prefill unavailable, using CK: %r", e)
+        return None
+    return mha
+
+
+def enabled(
+    use_prefill_query_quantization: bool,
+    head_size: int,
+    kv_cache_dtype: str,
+    plain_attention: bool,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether a layer's prefill and extend calls use the FP8 Triton path.
+
+    ``plain_attention`` is False for layers with ALiBi, sinks or a sliding window.
+    """
+    if not use_prefill_query_quantization:
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    if not (
+        get_cdna_version() == 3
+        and head_size == _HEAD_DIM
+        and kv_cache_dtype in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3")
+        and plain_attention
+    ):
+        logger.info_once(
+            "FP8 prefill attention on ROCM_AITER_FA needs gfx942, head size %d, "
+            "an FP8 E4M3 KV cache and no ALiBi, sinks or sliding window; "
+            "using CK for this layer",
+            _HEAD_DIM,
+        )
+        return False
+    if _load_kernel() is None:
+        return False
+    logger.info_once("FP8 prefill attention enabled for ROCM_AITER_FA")
+    return True
+
+
+def prefill_attn() -> Callable[..., Any]:
+    """Return the varlen attention for an enabled layer's prefill and extend."""
+    return functools.partial(
+        triton_fp8_prefill_attn, orig=rocm_aiter_ops.flash_attn_varlen_func
+    )
+
+
+def _workspace_shapes(
+    num_q_tokens: int, num_kv_tokens: int, num_q_heads: int, num_kv_heads: int
+) -> list[tuple[tuple[int, ...], torch.dtype]]:
+    fp8 = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+    shapes: list[tuple[tuple[int, ...], torch.dtype]] = [
+        ((num_q_tokens, num_q_heads, _HEAD_DIM), fp8)
+    ]
+    if num_kv_tokens:
+        shapes += [((num_kv_tokens, num_kv_heads, _HEAD_DIM), fp8)] * 2
+    return shapes
+
+
+def profile(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    num_q_heads: int,
+    num_kv_heads: int,
+    num_kv_tokens: int,
+    num_q_tokens: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Allocate during the profile run what the widest prefill will use.
+
+    ``query`` gives dtype and device only. Its row count is not the bound: with
+    microbatching the profile run splits the batch across ubatches, while a
+    later step can run unsplit at the full width on the same workspace slot.
+    """
+    current_workspace_manager().get_simultaneous(
+        *_workspace_shapes(num_q_tokens, num_kv_tokens, num_q_heads, num_kv_heads)
+    )
+    # aiter allocates an FP32 output inside the call, then it is cast.
+    torch.empty(
+        (num_q_tokens, num_q_heads, _HEAD_DIM),
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device=query.device,
+    ).to(query.dtype)
+
+
+def _eligible(
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    alibi_slopes,
+    sink_ptr,
+    window_size,
+    dropout_p,
+    causal=False,
+    cu_seqlens_q=None,
+    cu_seqlens_k=None,
+    kv_is_fp8=False,
+) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    if q.ndim != 3 or k.ndim != 3 or v.ndim != 3:
+        return False, "q/k/v must be [tokens, heads, head_dim]"
+    if q.shape[-1] != _HEAD_DIM:
+        return False, f"head_dim {q.shape[-1]} != {_HEAD_DIM}"
+    if k.shape[-1] != _HEAD_DIM or v.shape[-1] != _HEAD_DIM:
+        return False, "k/v head_dim mismatch"
+    if q.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+        return False, f"dtype {q.dtype} not bf16/fp16"
+    kv_dtype = current_platform.fp8_dtype() if kv_is_fp8 else q.dtype
+    if k.dtype != kv_dtype or v.dtype != kv_dtype:
+        return False, f"k/v dtype {k.dtype}/{v.dtype} != {kv_dtype}"
+    if k.shape[1] != v.shape[1]:
+        return False, f"num_k_heads {k.shape[1]} != num_v_heads {v.shape[1]}"
+    if q.shape[1] % k.shape[1] != 0:
+        return False, (
+            f"num_q_heads {q.shape[1]} is not a multiple of num_kv_heads {k.shape[1]}"
+        )
+    if q.shape[0] == 0 or k.shape[0] == 0 or k.shape[0] != v.shape[0]:
+        return False, f"token counts q={q.shape[0]} k={k.shape[0]} v={v.shape[0]}"
+    for cu in (cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k):
+        if cu is not None and cu.dtype != torch.int32:
+            return False, f"cu_seqlens dtype {cu.dtype} != int32"
+    if alibi_slopes is not None:
+        return False, "alibi not supported"
+    if sink_ptr is not None:
+        return False, "attention sink not supported"
+    if window_size is not None and tuple(window_size) != (-1, -1):
+        return False, f"sliding window {tuple(window_size)} not supported"
+    if dropout_p:
+        return False, "dropout not supported"
+    if causal and cu_seqlens_k is not cu_seqlens_q:
+        # aiter writes LSE 0 for causal rows with no key; a value check would sync.
+        return False, "causal with separate cu_seqlens_q and cu_seqlens_k"
+    return True, ""
+
+
+def _descale(scale: torch.Tensor, n_heads: int, batch: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # aiter reads descales at [b, head] with an implicit unit head stride.
+    return scale.expand(batch, n_heads).contiguous()
+
+
+def _quant(t: torch.Tensor, buf: torch.Tensor, n_heads: int, batch: int):
+    _, scale = ops.scaled_fp8_quant(
+        t.reshape(t.shape[0], -1), output=buf.view(t.shape[0], -1)
+    )
+    return buf, _descale(scale, n_heads, batch)
+
+
+def triton_fp8_prefill_attn(*, orig: Callable[..., Any], **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
+    """Run an eligible call with aiter's Triton MHA on FP8 Q/K/V, else ``orig``.
+
+    ``k``/``v`` are either in ``q``'s dtype, or FP8 with one ``descale_k`` and
+    ``descale_v`` scale each, which ``orig`` cannot take.
+    """
+    return _triton_or_orig(orig, kwargs, **kwargs)
+
+
+def _triton_or_orig(
+    orig: Callable[..., Any],
+    kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    q,
+    k,
+    v,
+    cu_seqlens_q,
+    cu_seqlens_k,
+    max_seqlen_q,
+    max_seqlen_k,
+    min_seqlen_q=None,
+    dropout_p=0.0,
+    softmax_scale=None,
+    causal=False,
+    window_size=None,
+    alibi_slopes=None,
+    return_lse=False,
+    out=None,
+    sink_ptr=None,
+    descale_k=None,
+    descale_v=None,
+    **extra,
+):
+    kv_is_fp8 = descale_k is not None
+    # CK may act on kwargs this module does not know.
+    ok, why = (
+        (False, f"unexpected kwargs {sorted(extra)}")
+        if extra
+        else _eligible(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            alibi_slopes,
+            sink_ptr,
+            window_size,
+            dropout_p,
+            causal,
+            cu_seqlens_q,
+            cu_seqlens_k,
+            kv_is_fp8,
+        )
+    )
+    if not ok:
+        if kv_is_fp8:
+            raise ValueError(f"FP8 K/V call is not eligible for Triton: {why}")
+        logger.info_once("FP8 Triton prefill INELIGIBLE (%s); using the CK path", why)
+        return orig(**kwargs)
+
+    n_q_heads, n_kv_heads = q.shape[1], k.shape[1]
+    batch = cu_seqlens_q.numel() - 1
+    scale = softmax_scale if softmax_scale is not None else q.shape[-1] ** -0.5
+
+    bufs = current_workspace_manager().get_simultaneous(
+        *_workspace_shapes(
+            q.shape[0], 0 if kv_is_fp8 else k.shape[0], n_q_heads, n_kv_heads
+        )
+    )
+    q8, dq = _quant(q, bufs[0], n_q_heads, batch)
+    if kv_is_fp8:
+        k8, v8 = k, v
+        dk = _descale(descale_k, n_kv_heads, batch)
+        dv = _descale(descale_v, n_kv_heads, batch)
+    else:
+        k8, dk = _quant(k, bufs[1], n_kv_heads, batch)
+        v8, dv = _quant(v, bufs[2], n_kv_heads, batch)
+    mha = _load_kernel()
+    assert mha is not None
+    o, lse = mha._flash_attn_forward(
+        q8,
+        k8,
+        v8,
+        dropout_p=0.0,
+        softmax_scale=scale,
+        causal=bool(causal),
+        window_size_left=-1,
+        window_size_right=-1,
+        bias=None,
+        alibi_slopes=None,
+        return_lse=bool(return_lse),
+        return_softmax=False,
+        # Real lengths come from cu_seqlens; rounding avoids per-length recompiles.
+        max_seqlen_q=round_up(int(max_seqlen_q), 16),
+        max_seqlen_k=round_up(int(max_seqlen_k), 16),
+        cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,
+        cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens_k,
+        descale_q=dq,
+        descale_k=dk,
+        descale_v=dv,
+        sink=None,
+        config=dict(_TUNED_CONFIG),
+    )[:2]
+
+    logger.info_once(
+        "FP8 Triton prefill ACTIVE hd=%d Hq=%d Hkv=%d causal=%s return_lse=%s",
+        q.shape[-1],
+        n_q_heads,
+        n_kv_heads,
+        bool(causal),
+        bool(return_lse),
+    )
+    o = out.copy_(o) if out is not None else o.to(q.dtype)
+    if not return_lse:
+        return o
+    return o, lse.transpose(0, 1)

+"""FP8 Triton prefill attention for the ROCM_AITER_FA backend on gfx942.
+
+With ``VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_FP8_PREFILL=1``, eligible prefill and extend
+calls run aiter's Triton MHA on FP8 Q/K/V instead of CK. Every other call runs
+the original CK call with its arguments unchanged. If the aiter kernel cannot
+be loaded or a launch raises, the path disables itself with one warning and
+CK is used from then on. An out-of-memory error is the exception: that call
+falls back to CK but the path stays enabled.
+
+Numerics: Q, K and V each get ONE scale per call, from the amax over every
+token and head in the call. The path is lossy (about 4% relative error per head
+against CK on Gaussian inputs) and not batch invariant: a co-batched sequence
+with larger values, or one large channel such as a sink token, coarsens the
+quantisation of everything else in the call.
+
+aiter behaviour this relies on (0.1.21.post2 and 0.1.24):
+- ``descale_q`` is read at ``[b, q_head]`` and ``descale_k/v`` at
+  ``[b, kv_head]``, with no bounds check and an implicit unit head stride.
+- Causal rows that see no key get LSE 0, not -inf, so causal calls must be
+  square.
+- There is no head-dim-256 config; the default runs at about 0.29x of CK, so
+  ``_TUNED_CONFIG`` is a precondition.
+- The FP8 output is float32 and LSE is ``[tokens, heads]``; CK returns the
+  input dtype and ``[heads, tokens]``.
+"""

+from collections.abc import Callable
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any

+# 64x64/4 warps/1 stage, which spills 17 registers; this config spills none and
+# is 1.06x-1.15x faster on every long-context shape tried.
+_TUNED_CONFIG = {
+    "BLOCK_M": 128,
+    "BLOCK_N": 64,
+    "PRELOAD_V": True,
+    "waves_per_eu": 2,

+        "cu_seqlens_k",

+        "max_seqlen_k",

Thanks @frida-andersson for the quality review.  Both pointes are corrected and I now addressed them. 
For the first: the try/except is removed, so kernel errors including OOM raise instead of falling back. _fallback, _disable and the _kernel_ok global went with it.

The only check left is at load time: `_load_kernel`() probes `_flash_attn_forward` for the kwargs this path needs, so an aiter build without them keeps the layer on CK from the start instead of failing per call. I'd like to keep that one — it degrades to CK rather than taking the server down.

For the second: the FP8 Q/K/V buffers now come from vLLM's workspace manager and are reserved during the profile run, together with aiter's float32 output and its cast, so the profiler accounts for them. The reservation is sized from `scheduler_config`.`max_num_batched_tokens` rather than from the profile run's query, because under microbatching the profile batch is split and a later unsplit step would outgrow it.

Done. Summary of the three gather sites:

| call site | cache layout | before | now |
|---|---|---|---|
| extend context chunk | NHD (default) | dequant to bf16, requant with a fresh scale | read as FP8, cache scales as `descale_k`/`descale_v` |
| KV-sharing layer | NHD (default) | dequant to bf16, requant with a fresh scale | read as FP8, cache scales as `descale_k`/`descale_v` |

The chunk is gathered with `dequant=False` into the extend workspace viewed as FP8, and the
module broadcasts the per-tensor cache scale to `[batch, num_kv_heads]`, which is the layout
the kernel indexes. The second row is the call site your comment implies but doesn't name: a
KV-sharing layer projects only Q and reads K/V back from the target layer's cache, and that
gather had the identical round trip.

I left SHUFFLE alone because it's a separate gather kernel I haven't validated; it's off by
default, so the default path no longer quantises twice. At the kernel level the round trip was
~1% of a 30720x32768 context-chunk call (0.43 ms of 45 ms), so the value is correctness rather
than speed.

Covered by `test_extend_with_context_matches_ck[nhd|shuffle]` and
`test_kv_sharing_prefill_reads_fp8_cache[nhd|shuffle]`, which assert the `dequant` flag and the
descales the kernel receives, and compare per-head error against CK reading the same cache.
